Its own site (sl and en) identifies participating banks, services and platform changes, and is the hinge that turns one vendor announcement into sector-wide regulatory-project intelligence.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated standing public-consultation register was found on bsi.si. Searches in Slovenian for 'javna obravnava', 'javno posvetovanje' and 'osnutek sklepa' scoped to bsi.si returned only publications, press releases and the site index — no consultation landing page or archive of draft sklepi with comment deadlines.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian-language consultation queries returned bsi.si publications pages (letno poročilo, poročilo o finančni stabilnosti, kazalo vsebine) and no consultation hub. English-language equivalents likewise produced nothing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The A3 topic 'consultations' cannot be satisfied from the NCB alone for Slovenia. Consultation signal for the SI banking/payments framework must instead be taken from the e-demokracija portal (primary legislation, proposer Ministrstvo za finance), from BS press releases, and from EU-level consultations (ECB/EBA) that BS implements. This should be treated as a structural feature of the SI landscape, not a search failure — though it is worth one manual confirmation pass.

negative_findings.description: Guessed URL paths https://www.bsi.si/sl/zakonodaja-in-predpisi and https://www.bsi.si/en/legislation both returned HTTP 404. The correct Slovenian path is /sl/pravni-okvir.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two 404s on guessed slugs; correct path found via homepage navigation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: bsi.si slugs are not predictable and the EN paths are not literal translations of the SL paths. Any collector must discover URLs from the site index (/sl/kazalo-vsebine) or on-page navigation rather than constructing them. A 404 here means 'wrong guess', not 'source dead'.

negative_findings.description: Search results indicate that Uradni list RS issues published after 28 February 2026 are made available through PISRS rather than the classic uradni-list.si gazette flow. This was surfaced in a search summary and has NOT been confirmed against a primary announcement.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hypothesis only; the classic uradni-list.si issue index for 2026 (e.g. issue 16/2026, 27.2.2026) was still visible in results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If true, a collector anchored solely on uradni-list.si issue indexes would silently stop capturing newly published Banka Slovenije sklepi from March 2026 onward. Both uradni-list.si and pisrs.si must be monitored, and this change must be verified against an official notice before any pipeline is built.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed was identified for Banka Slovenije press releases or for Uradni list RS during this pass. The only push mechanism observed is the bsi.si email newsletter ('Prijavite se na novice').
negative_findings.result_summary: Explicit RSS-targeted search returned no feed URLs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection will likely have to rely on scheduled HTML crawling and diffing rather than feeds, which raises fragility and cost. A dedicated pass should probe for /feed, /rss, sitemap.xml and any JSON listing endpoints behind the bsi.si filtered listings (the ?q[...] query parameters suggest a backing API worth probing).

negative_findings.description: Several Slovenian commercial legal aggregators (zakonodaja.com, racunovodstvo.net, racunovodja.com, megafon.si) rank highly for BS sklep queries and reproduce act texts, sometimes in outdated consolidated versions (e.g. ZBan-1 NPB texts long superseded by ZBan-3).
negative_findings.result_summary: Multiple hits per query pointed to secondary reproductions rather than PISRS/Uradni list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Using these as sources risks quoting repealed law. They were deliberately NOT recorded as candidates. Any query pipeline for this cell should down-rank or blocklist these domains and force resolution to pisrs.si / uradni-list.si / bsi.si.

negative_findings.description: https://www.a-tvp.si/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain server-side fetch, so no ATVP page structure could be confirmed by direct retrieval in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Site is almost certainly live (multiple current deep links appear in search results); 403 indicates bot defence, not a dead host. All ATVP entries recorded as unverified with blocked=true.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ATVP is a critical cell source. Collection pipeline must use a headless browser or realistic headers, otherwise the securities supervisor will silently drop out of monitoring.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated standing 'javna posvetovanja' index page was confirmed for ATVP or UPPD; consultations appear to be announced as individual news items rather than in a structured consultation register.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATVP consultations found only as /novica/ items (e.g. 'Javni posvet o osnutkih dokumentov ESMA'). AZN by contrast has a 'Predpisi v pripravi' subsection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deadline tracking for ATVP/UPPD must rely on news-feed keyword monitoring, which is noisier and more fragile than a structured consultation index.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom or open API endpoint was confirmed for a-tvp.si, a-zn.si, ip-rs.si or the UPPD gov.si pages during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only HTML section pages were observed; feed discovery was not performed at HTML-source level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should assume HTML diffing plus PDF mirroring; a follow-up pass should check /rss, /feed and gov.si content APIs before building scrapers.

negative_findings.description: The exact URL of Slovenia's MONEYVAL 6th-round mutual evaluation report was not located; only the fact of its publication (via the UPPD site) and the MONEYVAL landing page are recorded.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded at issuer-site level with confidence 0.7 rather than inventing a document URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The evaluation report and its follow-up timetable are the single best forward indicator of Slovenian AML tightening; the precise link should be resolved in a targeted pass.

negative_findings.description: English-language versions of ATVP, AZN and UPPD content were not confirmed in this pass; all confirmed material is Slovenian.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search seeds in English returned mostly Slovenian-language official pages; no separate /en supervisory guidance trees verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream collection and NLP must be Slovenian-capable; assuming English mirrors exist would create silent coverage loss.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian law firm was found publishing a dedicated, subscribable banking/payments regulatory alert series (the CEE-standard 'financial regulation newsletter'). SI firms publish general mixed-topic article streams instead, with banking items interleaved among tax, disputes and procurement.
negative_findings.result_summary: Jadek & Pensa and ODI both have verified live article feeds, but neither showed a banking/payments-specific alert category in the items observed; searches for 'client alert' plus SI firm names returned rankings pages, not alert archives.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell must be keyword-filtered across general firm feeds rather than subscribed to a clean topic channel, which raises noise and makes recall dependent on good sl/en keyword lists.

negative_findings.description: The sl-language query combining practitioner publication terms with PSD3/MiCA/DORA and 2026 returned no SI adviser commentary at all — results were regulator, government and general-press pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query '"pravne novice" OR "pravni nasvet" odvetniki Slovenija DORA PSD3 MiCA banke publikacije 2026' surfaced Banka Slovenije, GOV.SI, Uradni list and Andersen tax news, but no law-firm regulatory alerts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either SI advisers publish PSD3/MiCA commentary in English only, or such commentary is thin in SI relative to tax and employment topics. Both readings change how much of this cell's value is actually local-language.

negative_findings.description: Two important candidates returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch: PwC Slovenija Pravne novice and CEE Legal Matters Slovenia.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 Forbidden on both; both are well-indexed by search engines, so the hypothesis is bot defense rather than removal. Neither is recorded as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive collector will silently record zero items for two of the highest-value channels in this cell unless it uses a browser-grade fetcher.

negative_findings.description: Domains for Šelih & partnerji (selih.si) and Senica in partnerji (senica.si) were inferred from firm names and ranking commentary, not confirmed by fetch or by a search result linking to the firm's own site.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned directory profiles (IFLR1000, Legal 500, Chambers) rather than the firms' own homepages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These entries must be treated as leads for manual confirmation, not as collectable endpoints; publishing them as verified would breach the no-fabrication rule.

negative_findings.description: The only Deloitte SI 'Finančne novičke' issues locatable via search were from 2018, on the legacy www2.deloitte.com path.
negative_findings.result_summary: No 2024-2026 issue of the SI financial-services newsletter was surfaced; the series may have ended or migrated to the newer deloitte.com/si structure.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Scheduling a collector against the legacy path risks tracking a dead series while missing a live one at a new URL.

negative_findings.description: No established Slovenian-language shorthand was found for PSD3/PSR in adviser writing; SI sources use the English acronyms untranslated, and only DORA has a settled Slovenian rendering ('uredba o digitalni operativni odpornosti').
negative_findings.result_summary: sl searches on PSD3 returned nothing from SI advisers; DORA's Slovenian long form is attested on PwC SI.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language querying for payments-directive commentary must use the English acronym embedded in Slovenian sentences, plus the domestic statute names (ZPlaSSIED, ZBan-3), or recall will be near zero.

negative_findings.description: Slovene-language queries aimed at media (Finance.si, Delo, Dnevnik, Svet kapitala) were answered almost entirely with bsi.si, uradni-list.si and pisrs.si results — the search backend is US-indexed and under-indexes sl media article pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: 3 of 4 sl seed queries returned zero media-domain results; official regulator/legal domains dominated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Media coverage cannot be discovered reliably through this search path; article-level discovery for this cell must run through on-site search, RSS and sitemaps, or a sl-aware search index.

negative_findings.description: Direct fetches were refused for finance.si and dnevnik.si (tool-level refusal), sta.si returned HTTP 403, and svetkapitala.delo.si/finance/ 302-redirected to napaka.delo.si (an error page).
negative_findings.result_summary: 4 of 4 attempted media fetches failed; none confirmed dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are hypotheses of bot defence and path change, not evidence of dead sources; the deterministic verification pass must retry with a browser-like agent before any of these is downgraded.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed URL was confirmed for any outlet in this cell, because every section fetch failed or was not attempted.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero verified feed endpoints.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection method for the whole cell is currently unspecified at the technical level; feed discovery is a prerequisite for automated monitoring.

negative_findings.description: No established sl-language term was found for 'public consultation register' in the media context; media use descriptive phrasing ('javna razprava', 'usklajevanje', 'medresorsko usklajevanje') rather than a fixed label.
negative_findings.result_summary: Glossary term unresolved for consultation-tracking keyword filters.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword monitoring for consultation controversies will need a broad phrase set rather than one canonical term, raising false-positive rates.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, standalone 'banking/payments ombudsman' institution exists in Slovenia comparable to the UK FOS or Irish FSPO. The consumer-vs-bank function is split between Banka Slovenije (supervisory complaint intake, no power to award redress to the individual) and the industry-hosted ZBS IRPS mediator.
negative_findings.result_summary: Repeated SL and EN searches for a banking ombudsman surfaced only ZBS IRPS, the insurance-side varuh dobrih poslovnih običajev, and the general human-rights Varuh — none is a banking-specific redress ombudsman.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Analysts must not expect a single authoritative decisions database; complaint intelligence has to be assembled from at least three heterogeneous channels, and ADR outcome data is industry-published rather than regulator-published.

negative_findings.description: No machine-readable, per-institution complaint statistics dataset for Slovenian banks/PSPs was found (nothing equivalent to a published complaints-by-firm table).
negative_findings.result_summary: Aggregate figures appear only as narrative in ZBS/ZPS reporting (e.g. 119 new initiatives filed in the year, 29 carried over from 2023, 133 of 148 open cases resolved) and, presumably, in annual reports as PDF prose.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Trend analysis will require PDF text extraction and manual coding; per-bank attribution may be impossible, limiting competitive benchmarking.

negative_findings.description: The Ministry's IRPS provider list is still indexed at the pre-migration mgrt.gov.si path; the current canonical location on gov.si was not pinned in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned http://www.mgrt.gov.si/si/delovna_podrocja/.../seznam_izvajalcev_irps/ ; gov.si consolidation means this is almost certainly redirected or gone. Not fetched, so status unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector pointed at the legacy URL would silently fail; the OPSI open-data register should be the primary machine-readable fallback.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian consumer-complaint aggregator or public complaint-review forum specific to banking/payments (a 'complaints board' style site) was identified in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced only institutional and NGO channels; generic consumer forums were not located with the terms used.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Grassroots weak signals (e.g. fraud waves, app outages) may be missed; social/forum discovery needs a separate targeted pass with terms like 'forum banka goljufija', 'prevara SMS banka'.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched for liveness; all entries are search-derived. ZBS PDF paths under /wp-content/uploads/ are date-partitioned and may rotate.
negative_findings.result_summary: Deterministic verification pass required; do not treat any listed URL as confirmed reachable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents false confidence in the collection plan.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian 'compliance day' / regulatory-compliance conference brand was found (analogue of e.g. a national Compliance Forum). Searches on 'konferenca skladnost poslovanja' returned only general business-education organisers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Compliance-specific agenda content appears to be embedded inside broader events (ZBS banking conference, Davčno-finančna konferenca, Dnevi slovenskih pravnikov) rather than a standalone series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Agenda monitoring must be done per-event across several organisers rather than via one calendar, raising collection cost and risk of missed sessions.

negative_findings.description: MojeDelo.com — a major SI job portal — did not surface directly in search results for compliance/DORA/AML keywords; only competitor portals (Optius, Borza dela) did.
negative_findings.result_summary: Portal likely blocks or deprioritises search-engine indexing of individual listings. Its own on-site search was not exercised in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A significant share of SI bank vacancies may be invisible to search-engine-based discovery, biasing any hiring-signal time series.

negative_findings.description: It was not confirmed whether Banka Slovenije publishes misdemeanour fines (globe) against banks as a structured, complete list or only ad-hoc PDFs. One example PDF ('Razkritje informacij o izrečeni sankciji pravni in odgovorni osebi') was seen under a storage URL rather than a register row.
negative_findings.result_summary: The 'Informacije o izrečenih ukrepih' page exists; its completeness, retention and structure were not verified in this pass and no page was fetched.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If sanction disclosures are time-limited (common under statutory publication rules), a collector must snapshot on discovery or the record is lost.

negative_findings.description: No established Slovenian-language term was found for supervisory-technology / RegTech vendor-side hiring, nor a Slovenian PSP/fintech industry association career hub. English 'compliance officer' and 'AML' are used untranslated in SI postings alongside 'skladnost poslovanja'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Glossary must run bilingual keyword sets on the same corpus; sl-only sweeps will under-count.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Monolingual keyword monitoring in either language systematically misses postings.

negative_findings.description: No aggregated national register of financial-sector fines across BS + ATVP + AZN + AML Office was found; each supervisor publishes separately in its own format.
negative_findings.result_summary: Four separate registers must be monitored and normalised.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cross-supervisor sanction intensity comparisons require in-house normalisation; no shortcut exists.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian fintech/payments industry association (an EMI/PI trade body distinct from Združenje bank Slovenije and from the blockchain associations) surfaced in sl- or en-language searches.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language queries on 'fintech združenje Slovenija' returned only blockchain/crypto associations (Blockchain Alliance Europe, SBCA, Bitcoin društvo) and startup media, no EMI/PI trade body.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a fintech trade body, non-bank payment actors' lobbying positions must be reconstructed from individual firms' consultation submissions on e-demokracija, which is slower and less complete.

negative_findings.description: No publicly reachable, dated API changelog / release-notes feed was identified for SI banks' PSD2 portals in this pass; portals expose product and documentation pages, with change history likely behind developer registration.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bankart hub and developer.nlb.me expose API products, Swagger and support pages; no open 'changelog' or 'release notes' URL was found via search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hard compliance dates for API specification changes are a core signal for this cell; if change history is gated, collection needs a registered developer account or specification-file diffing instead.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched or confirmed reachable; all entries rest on search-result evidence and are unverified pending the deterministic liveness pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Discovery was done via sl and en web search only; no page fetches were performed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deep-link paths (especially bsi.si section paths and e-uprava predlog-predpisa ids) are fragile and may have moved; treat any failure as 'moved/bot-defended', not dead.

negative_findings.description: The exact current population of SI-authorised CASPs is uncertain: media report 'three licensed companies remain of 35' and EU-register trackers report a small SI count, but the authoritative ATVP register listing page for CASPs was not directly enumerated.
negative_findings.result_summary: Named SI CASP/MiCA actors found: Ilirika (reported first ATVP MiCA licence), Incrementum d.o.o., and Dinaro (EMI, reported first SI entry on the ESMA EMT list).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Actor-map completeness for the crypto half of this cell depends on enumerating the ATVP register directly rather than from press counts.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, publicly maintained Slovenia-specific transposition table for banking and payments directives (PSD2/PSD3, CRD, DORA) was found outside the generic PISRS EU-acts register and the EUR-Lex NIM tab. Neither Banka Slovenije nor the Ministry of Finance appears to publish a per-directive correlation table ('korelacijska tabela') publicly.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in sl and en; only generic registers surfaced. Correlation tables are typically attached to individual bill files (predlog zakona) rather than published as a standing dataset.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Directive-to-article mapping must be reconstructed from bill annexes on e-demokracija/DZ rather than pulled from a maintained table, raising collection cost and staleness risk.

negative_findings.description: Fetch of https://pisrs.si/zbirke/pravni-akti-EU returned only the page title with no body content — likely a JavaScript-rendered single-page application rather than a dead page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Content not extractable via plain HTTP-to-markdown fetch. Register field descriptions were confirmed only from search-result summaries, not from the live page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection from PISRS will need a headless browser or the documented PISRS API; a naive HTTP crawler will silently collect empty records.

negative_findings.description: No specific evidence was found of archived/withdrawn Banka Slovenije consultations or superseded supervisory deadline pages via general web search; search engines index the live site, not its Wayback snapshots.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search for archived bsi.si consultations returned only live pages. The recovery path is a direct CDX query against bsi.si, not a search engine.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recovery of withdrawn drafts must be done by direct archive querying in the collection pipeline; the discovery phase cannot confirm what is recoverable.

negative_findings.description: Tax-Fin-Lex (and, by the same market pattern, IUS-INFO/Lex localis) place full consolidated texts, version timelines and 'predpisi v pripravi' behind subscription login.
negative_findings.result_summary: Document detail URLs redirect to a login page; only marketing pages and some news items are open.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The richest Slovenian regulatory-tracker layer is not lawfully collectable without a licence; the open substitute is PISRS + Uradni list, which lack the curated timeline view.

negative_findings.description: The acronym ATVP was pursued as the Slovenian securities market agency (Agencija za trg vrednostnih papirjev) but search results conflated it with an audiovisual media regulator, and no archived-consultation evidence was retrieved for it or for azn.si (Agencija za zavarovalni nadzor).
negative_findings.result_summary: No usable results; these non-banking supervisors were not confirmed as sources within this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cross-sector supervisors (securities, insurance) publish consultations relevant to payments/banking overlap; their archive layer remains uncovered.

negative_findings.description: uradni-list.si carries an explicit transition notice that, as of 1 March 2026, official publication moved to the Pravni informacijski sistem Republike Slovenije (PISRS), and that content shown on uradni-list.si is archival under Article 33 of the ZoUL.
negative_findings.result_summary: Any collector built against uradni-list.si URL patterns alone will silently stop seeing newly published acts after Mar 2026. The authoritative feed for anything published after that date is PISRS.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is the single largest structural break in the cell. A pipeline anchored on the old gazette would fail open - it would keep returning 200s on archived pages while missing every new statutory deadline.

negative_findings.description: Both pisrs.si (homepage) and pisrs.si/swagger/navodila returned title-only content to a plain markdown-converting fetcher, indicating client-side rendering.
negative_findings.result_summary: No navigation, endpoint list or terms could be read directly. Endpoint hints (/predpis/..., daily refresh by ~07:00, /api/uradni-list/objava/{issue}.pdf) come from search-result snippets only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most important source in the cell is the one hardest to read with a simple fetcher. A browser-capable or API-first collection pass is required before this source can be relied on. This is a hypothesis about rendering, NOT a finding that the site is unavailable.

negative_findings.description: No RSS or Atom feed was identified for the e-Demokracija predlogi predpisov listing, despite it being the earliest-signal consultation source in the cell.
negative_findings.result_summary: The rendered listing exposes ministry/type/subject filters and a 'commentable only' toggle, but no feed URL surfaced in the page content read.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Consultation deadlines will have to be captured by polling and diffing HTML rather than by subscribing, which raises maintenance cost and the risk of missing a short comment window.

negative_findings.description: Government session materials live on a legacy Lotus Domino repository split by parliamentary mandate (gradiva.vlada.si/mandat22/..., vrs-3.vlada.si/MANDAT20/...) with GUID-based paths and .doc/.pdf attachments.
negative_findings.result_summary: Documents are publicly reachable but the URLs are not predictable or durable across mandates.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Explanatory memoranda - which contain the intended entry-into-force and the consultation response summaries - cannot be systematically crawled and must be resolved via EVA/IPP numbers and archived immediately on discovery.

negative_findings.description: English-language searching ('Slovenia official gazette banking act amendment entry into force') surfaced no authoritative English channel for Slovenian primary banking legislation.
negative_findings.result_summary: All authoritative primary-law sources in this cell publish in Slovene only. English exists only as unofficial supervisor translations or EU-level transposition notices.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that Slovene-language collection is not optional for workstream A3 in SI; an English-only pipeline would have near-zero recall on statutory deadlines.

negative_findings.description: The GOV.SI page for the Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja was constructed from the standard organi-v-sestavi URL scheme rather than read directly during this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: The office's existence and its ownership of ZPPDFT are well evidenced; the specific URL is inferred.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Per the hard rules this is recorded as unverified rather than asserted as live; the deterministic verification pass should resolve or correct it.

negative_findings.description: Neither the EBA nor the ECB Banking Supervision consultation registers publish consultation papers or deadlines in Slovenian; only final Guidelines are translated into SL, and typically months after the consultation has closed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian-language searching surfaced EBA SL guideline PDFs but no SL-language consultation or deadline listing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any monitoring design that relies on Slovenian-language triggers will systematically miss the earliest (consultation-stage) lead time; EN monitoring of EU bodies is mandatory and SL is only usable downstream.

negative_findings.description: No EU-level source found that pre-filters EBA/ECB/ESRB output by Slovenian applicability. The only Slovenia-specific EU-level artefacts located were EBA guideline compliance tables (per-NCA rows) and ESRB national-policy tables (per-country rows).
negative_findings.result_summary: Country filtering must be constructed by the collector from these two per-country structures plus Banka Slovenije pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines the pipeline architecture: EU-wide harvest plus a derived SI-applicability join, rather than a country feed.

negative_findings.description: The EPC Register of Participants URL path was inferred from site structure, not confirmed by a fetch in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded with reduced confidence (0.6); path may differ.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated-looking dead link from being treated as verified; the deterministic liveness pass should resolve it.

negative_findings.description: No stable Slovenian-language term was found in circulation for 'Verification of Payee' — SI and EU-SL material appears to use the English term or the EPC acronym VOP rather than a settled SL translation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language searching on VoP concepts is unreliable; use 'preverjanje prejemnika plačila' as a hypothesis only, and rely on EN/acronym matching.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Affects glossary quality and recall of SL-language payments monitoring.

negative_findings.description: No publicly published Flik scheme rulebook ('pravila sheme Flik' / 'pravilnik sheme') was found on bankart.si or any SI bank site, despite bank privacy notices explicitly citing 'pravila slovenske nacionalne sheme Flik'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in Slovenian for scheme rules, participant rules and adherence documents; only derived artefacts surfaced (bank general terms, privacy rules, merchant onboarding manuals). The rulebook appears to be distributed only to adhering participants.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Flik participant deadlines must be reconstructed indirectly from bank terms, Halcom/vendor release notes and Bankart notices; no single authoritative public deadline document exists for this scheme.

negative_findings.description: Bankart's participant-facing area ('Poslovno' / poslovni portal) was not reachable as open content; no public index of participant circulars, release calendars or scheme change notices was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Site navigation fetch listed a 'Poslovno' section, but no open document repository or release-calendar page was found behind it via search or direct fetch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The hardest operational deadlines for SI banks (release windows, mandatory upgrade dates) most likely live behind this gate, so this cell has a structural blind spot that only indirect sources can partly cover.

negative_findings.description: Several bsi.si deep paths under /financna-stabilnost/nadzor-placil-in-infrastruktur/... and /placila-in-infrastruktura/... returned HTTP 404 on fetch while still being surfaced by search engines; an azurewebsites.net staging mirror of bsi.si also appears in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three separate deep-path fetches to bsi.si returned 404; the parent hub pages fetched fine.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell must crawl bsi.si from section roots rather than persisting deep URLs, otherwise the pipeline will report false 'dead source' verdicts. These are hypotheses of URL migration, not evidence the pages are gone.

negative_findings.description: The UPN QR verification centre (Center za preverjanje pravilnosti QR kode in tiska obrazcev UPN QR) is reported as no longer operating, following a decision of the ZBS Payment Transactions Committee (Odbor za plačilni promet ZBS).
negative_findings.result_summary: Found stated on upn-qr.si-derived content; the ZBS committee decision itself was not located as a public document.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Governance of the UPN QR standard is changing; the ZBS Odbor za plačilni promet is a decision-making body whose outputs are only partly public and should be treated as a named target for future scouting.

negative_findings.description: Dinit d.o.o. is listed as a payment system operator / NSP member, but no operator website section describing its payment system, rulebook or participant obligations was found in either Slovenian or English search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sl for 'Dinit plačilni sistem upravljavec' returned only legal-framework and NSP membership references, no operator documentation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An authorised SI system operator in this cell currently has no tracked primary source; the Banka Slovenije operator register must be used as the entry point instead.

negative_findings.description: No standalone official Flik scheme domain (e.g. flik.si) was confirmed; all authoritative Flik content found sits under bankart.si or on participant bank domains.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched 'Flik Pay flik.si pravila uporabe shema banke udeleženke' in Slovenian; results resolved to bankart.si and bank sites only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection should be anchored on bankart.si + bank sites; assuming a scheme-branded domain would create a phantom source.

negative_findings.description: Neither the SL nor the EN Banka Slovenije pages exposed stable per-category deep links (e.g. a standalone URL for 'plačilne institucije' or 'ponudniki storitev zagotavljanja informacij o računih'). The register appears to be a single filterable listing (~372 entries) with a 'show more' control rather than separate static pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the parent register URL could be captured with confidence; category-specific URLs were not observed and were therefore not recorded.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must handle a dynamic filter UI (likely an AJAX/JSON endpoint) rather than assuming one static page per entity type; a naive single-page fetch will under-collect.

negative_findings.description: No documented API, CSV or XML export of the Banka Slovenije Register subjektov nadzora was found; the OPSI Banka Slovenije publisher listing surfaced statistical series and a payment-institution notification catalogue PDF, but no register export.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register appears to be HTML-only for bulk purposes; open-data route unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Entity-population tracking for SI will likely require HTML scraping with careful diffing, which is more brittle and needs monitoring for layout changes.

negative_findings.description: EBA register URLs appeared in two forms across results (eba.europa.eu/risk-and-data-analysis/data/registers/... and .../registers-and-other-list-institutions/...), suggesting a site reorganisation with redirects.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both forms recorded as example_urls; neither claimed verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A downstream liveness check may see 301/302 or 404 on one variant; it should follow redirects rather than mark the source dead.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian register of AML/CFT-obliged entities or of virtual-asset service providers under the pre-MiCA regime (Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja) was located within this cell's search budget; MiCA CASPs are instead pointed to via the ESMA interim register through ATVP.
negative_findings.result_summary: AML supervisory-register angle left uncovered.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An AML-obliged-entity list would extend the actor population beyond prudentially licensed firms; worth a targeted follow-up.

negative_findings.description: NKBM (Nova KBM) and SKB banka no longer exist as separate legal entities: the legal merger was executed 22 Aug 2024 and operational merger completed 2 Sept 2024 into OTP banka d.d., Slovenska cesta 58, Ljubljana. The seed query's 'NKBM/OTP' framing must be resolved to a single current entity.
negative_findings.result_summary: No live standalone NKBM investor-relations channel found; nkbm.si content and SKB reports are archived under otpbanka.si. skb.si still serves legacy PDFs but is a decommissioning risk.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A source list keyed to NKBM or SKB will silently go stale; historical baselines must be pulled from the OTP archive before link rot.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian bank in this cell was found to publish a dedicated DORA-implementation disclosure page or a machine-readable regulatory-change feed (RSS/Atom/JSON). DORA content appears only embedded inside annual-report risk sections.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches combining DORA with sl bank terms returned regulator (Banka Slovenije) and generic pages, not bank-level DORA disclosures.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Operational-resilience regulatory impact must be extracted from long PDFs rather than monitored as a feed — raises collection cost and latency for that topic.

negative_findings.description: OTP banka serves documents through opaque numeric endpoints (/downloadfile.ashx?fileid=NNNNNN and /prenos-datoteke/NNNNNN/). These IDs are not semantically enumerable and can be re-issued.
negative_findings.result_summary: Document links must be resolved by crawling the index page each run; direct URL construction is not viable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector that caches deep links without re-crawling the index will accumulate broken or wrong-document references.

negative_findings.description: www.nlb.si/vlagatelji returns HTTP 301 to www.nlbgroup.com/si-sl/vlagatelji (cross-host). Fetchers that do not follow cross-host redirects will record the canonical NLB IR entry point as unreachable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Redirect observed directly during this run; target not itself fetched, so treat as unverified-but-live.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Risk of falsely marking the single most important source in this cell as dead.

negative_findings.description: Delavska hranilnica operates content across both dh.si and delavska-hranilnica.si with overlapping notice/report sections.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both domains returned live-looking content in search results for the same document classes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without deduplication the same disclosure will be ingested twice and inflate signal counts.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated fintech/payments section within GZS was found. Searching the GZS section index and the seed query 'GZS fintech sekcija plačilne storitve regulativa' surfaced only ICT/telecom, cybersecurity, accounting-services and insurance-brokers bodies — no 'Sekcija za fintech' or 'Združenje za plačilne storitve'.
negative_findings.result_summary: GZS appears to have no fintech- or payments-specific section; payments advocacy sits with ZBS instead, digital topics with ZIT/SEKV.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids a wasted monitoring slot and confirms ZBS is the near-monopoly association channel for SI payments regulation.

negative_findings.description: No standalone Slovenian fintech industry association (an equivalent of e.g. Fintech Latvija or a 'Fintech Slovenija' body) was located in either Slovenian or English searches. The nearest self-organised industry structures are crypto/blockchain-focused (Blockchain Alliance Europe, Blockchain Think Tank Slovenije, Bitcoin društvo Slovenije) coordinating via the Digitalna koalicija working group.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned foreign fintech associations and Slovenian crypto bodies, but no SI-wide fintech association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means fintech-side positions on PSD3/PSR/instant payments must be picked up from ZBS, individual firms, or the blockchain associations, not from a single trade body.

negative_findings.description: ZBS does not appear to maintain a public, structured archive of its national consultation responses ('odzivi na javno obravnavo'); positions surface as press releases, media quotes from the director, or as text in annual reports. Its formal comment letters are, however, publicly archived on the EBA side.
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated 'stališča/odzivi' index page found on zbs-giz.si.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must combine the ZBS news feed, ZBS annual reports, EBA response uploads, and parliamentary dossiers rather than relying on one association page.

negative_findings.description: Bančni vestnik full-text access and the 'Programi za prijavo' portal's listing depth were not tested; member-only areas on TZS and Zbornica računovodskih servisov were not probed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Access status recorded as unverified rather than open or paywalled.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A deterministic liveness/access pass must confirm before these are scheduled for collection.

negative_findings.description: For AmCham Slovenia's committee structure no Slovenian-language terminology was used: the advocacy pages surfaced in English only ('Finance Committee', 'Investment Committee'). Slovenian equivalents ('odbor za finance') collide with the parliamentary committee of the same name and are noisy.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only coverage for this one actor; term flagged as noisy.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language monitoring rules for AmCham need a disambiguated query pattern (site-restricted) to avoid parliamentary false positives.

negative_findings.description: Targeted Slovenian-language searches for a Banka Slovenije public tender specifically for AML or supervisory-reporting software ('javno naročilo programska oprema poročanje Banka Slovenije AML') returned only Banka Slovenije's reporting-requirement and AML policy pages, no procurement notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: No specific central-bank AML/reporting-software tender was located via general web search; such notices are likely discoverable only inside the enarocanje.si / e-JN search interfaces, which are not well indexed by general search engines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that this cell cannot be worked from general web search alone — collection must go through the portal search forms and the TED API directly.

negative_findings.description: Individual enarocanje.si notice pages surface in search only as opaque parameterised URLs (e.g. /Obrazci/?id_obrazec=382041) with no readable title, and the archive path /arhiv/<id>/ likewise.
negative_findings.result_summary: Notice-level content on the national portal is effectively invisible to keyword search engines; only the ID is exposed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must enumerate via the portal's own search/pagination or via an ID-sweep, not via external search; also means dedupe keys should be notice IDs.

negative_findings.description: No pages were fetched in this pass; all sources are recorded from search-result evidence only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Liveness, robots.txt posture, rate limits and any bot defences (notably on enarocanje.si, ejn.gov.si JSF pages, dkom.si and ERAR) are untested.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must establish reachability and scraping constraints before any collector is built; a 403 on these should be treated as bot-defence, not death.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language equivalent term was found in this pass for the 'instant payments upgrade' procurement concept (e.g. a standard phrase such as 'takojšnja plačila' / 'plačila v realnem času') appearing in tender titles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Instant-payments-specific local tender vocabulary remains unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword filters for the SEPA Instant / IPR-driven procurement wave may miss Slovenian notices until the local phrase actually used by buyers is established from real notice titles.

negative_findings.description: No public vendor announcement of an AML/KYC transaction-monitoring implementation at a Slovenian bank was found in either language.
negative_findings.result_summary: English query on AML transaction monitoring go-lives in Slovenia returned only generic vendor listicles (SymphonyAI, ComplyAdvantage, Sumsub, Zigram) and the Banka Slovenije AML/CFT supervision page; the Slovenian-language query returned only generic AML explainers, a public-procurement IT guideline PDF and unrelated register pages. No named SI bank + named AML vendor pairing surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: AML/KYC is the single most deadline-dense regulatory area for SI banks (6th-round FATF/MONEYVAL evaluation ongoing 2025, AMLA/AML Package), yet the supplier channel appears publicly silent - meaning this workstream needs a different tactic (job ads, RFP leaks, conference speaker lists, bank annual reports) rather than vendor newsrooms.

negative_findings.description: Slovenian-language searching for vendor reference/customer pages ('reference', 'stranka', 'uvedba') is heavily polluted by unrelated senses of the words.
negative_findings.result_summary: 'referenca' in Slovenian overwhelmingly returns payment-reference (SI00/SI12 payment-order reference number) content; 'stranka' returns both 'customer' and 'political party'; 'dobavitelj' pulls generic supply-chain and procurement content. This crowded out vendor case-study pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Future runs must use narrower local phrasing ('študija primera', 'uspešna zgodba', 'implementacija v banki', 'projekt za banko', site: restricted to vendor domains) or the local-language channel will keep under-delivering on this cell.

negative_findings.description: No consolidated public directory of IT/regtech suppliers to Slovenian banks was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for a Slovenian supplier list/register serving NLB, NKBM, SKB, Addiko, Gorenjska banka etc. returned only bank-comparison consumer articles, forum threads and company-register pages - no association-maintained or media-maintained vendor directory.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The vendor map must be assembled bottom-up from individual vendor sites, conference sponsor lists and company registers; no shortcut exists, which raises the cost and the miss-rate of this cell.

negative_findings.description: The routine playbook path given in the brief could not be read from this machine.
negative_findings.result_summary: The stated path is a Windows Dropbox path (C:/Users/User/Dropbox/...), while this session runs on macOS; no equivalent local copy was located under the working directory.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This slice follows the inline METHOD in the brief only; any playbook-specific taxonomy or scoring conventions may not be exactly matched.

coverage_gaps.description: It is not established how Banka Slovenije consults the market before adopting a sklep — whether via targeted circulation to Združenje bank Slovenije, via the Nacionalni svet za plačila for payments matters, or not formally at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass: read one or two recent BS sklepi in Uradni list and trace backwards for any referenced consultation; check ZBS news around those dates; check NSP minutes for pre-consultation of payments acts; if still unresolved, note the FOI route documented in the Katalog informacij javnega značaja as the escalation option.

coverage_gaps.description: The bsi.si Pravni okvir database reports ~1,208 entries but was only sampled (12 shown per page). The actual set of Banka Slovenije-issued sklepi/navodila in force — as opposed to EU acts it merely lists — has not been enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Paginate the full /sl/pravni-okvir listing with the vrsta filter constrained to BS-issued instrument types, and cross-check completeness against the Katalog informacij javnega značaja.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is scoped to the NCB, but SI banking/payments supervision is split: ATVP (securities/investment services), AZN (insurance), Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja (AML FIU), Ministrstvo za finance (primary legislation), and ECB/SSM + EBA above BS. None were scouted here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm these are covered by sibling coverage cells; if not, flag for a follow-up cell — in particular the ECB/SSM layer, since for significant SI institutions the binding supervisory decision comes from the ECB and not from Banka Slovenije.

coverage_gaps.description: The bsi.si listings expose structured query parameters (?q[podrocje]=, ?q[vrsta]=, ?q[type]=), implying a backing API or at least stable structured pagination, but no API/JSON endpoint, sitemap.xml or robots.txt was probed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe https://www.bsi.si/robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, and the XHR traffic behind the Pravni okvir and Publikacije filters to find a JSON endpoint; that would make collection far cheaper and more robust than HTML diffing. Also record robots.txt constraints before any crawler is deployed.

coverage_gaps.description: English coverage of Banka Slovenije regulatory material is a partial subset of the Slovenian site and its URL structure differs (/en/legislation is a 404). The degree of EN/SL divergence for legally operative documents was not measured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample 10 recent SL legal-framework entries and record whether an EN counterpart exists and whether it is marked unofficial; set the SL corpus as authoritative and use EN only as a translation aid.

coverage_gaps.description: FURS (Financial Administration of RS) and the Tržni inšpektorat / consumer-protection supervisor were not searched, though both issue obligations touching payment services (e.g. tax reporting, consumer credit and unfair commercial practices).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up cell covering FURS, Tržni inšpektorat RS and the Ministry of Finance's financial-system directorate.

coverage_gaps.description: Court and appeal-level review of supervisory decisions (Upravno sodišče / Vrhovno sodišče case law via sodnapraksa.si) was not explored; supervisory positions are frequently reshaped by appeals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sodnapraksa.si as a candidate source and test keyword search for ATVP/AZN/IP-RS/UPPD decisions.

coverage_gaps.description: Systematic enforcement/sanctions publication points were only partially identified (AZN 'razkritje ukrepov nadzora'); equivalent publication points for ATVP (odločbe, javne objave sankcij), UPPD inspections, and IP-RS fines were not confirmed at URL level.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted pass per supervisor to locate the enforcement-publication path and its update cadence.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level originators (ESMA, EIOPA, EBA, EDPB, AMLA) are the upstream authors of much of what this cell republishes, but were treated as out-of-cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm another cell covers ESMA/EIOPA/EDPB/AMLA; otherwise the earliest lead time on obligations is lost.

coverage_gaps.description: ZDIJZ (freedom-of-information) as an active acquisition channel for non-published supervisory material was identified conceptually but not tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use AZN/ATVP 'katalog informacij javnega značaja' plus IP-RS FOI decisions to scope what is realistically obtainable, then decide whether requests are in scope for this programme.

coverage_gaps.description: Ketler & Partners (member of Karanovic) is the SI firm most explicitly ranked for payment services and fintech regulatory work, but its own publications channel was not located in this run — only its Chambers profile.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve the firm's own domain and insights feed and promote it to a direct candidate; it is likely the single best-fit adviser source for the payments half of this run's scope.

coverage_gaps.description: Verified adviser commentary skews English (ODI, Jadek & Pensa EN pages, CMS, Schoenherr, Wolf Theiss); confirmed sl-language regulatory alert streams are limited to PwC SI, Andersen SI and Bančni vestnik.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run local-language discovery using domestic statute acronyms (ZBan-3, ZPlaSSIED, ZPotK-2, ZCKR) and terms like 'novela', 'rok za uskladitev', 'obveznosti bank' rather than EU regulation names.

coverage_gaps.description: Cross-border legal aggregators that syndicate SI firm alerts (Lexology, Mondaq, JD Supra) were not searched in this run, and IUS-INFO/Lexpera (the other major SI legal portal alongside Tax-Fin-Lex) was named in a query but not confirmed as a source.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over Lexology/Mondaq filtered to Slovenia + banking/payments, and verify IUS-INFO/Lexpera and Pravna praksa (GV Založba) as SI commentary channels.

coverage_gaps.description: Consultations are the weakest topic in this cell: no adviser source was found that systematically tracks Slovenian or EBA/ECB consultation windows and their response deadlines for SI institutions.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do not rely on the advisory cell for consultation tracking; pair it with regulator-side workstreams, and check whether Schoenherr's regulatory roadmap or CMS Law-Now carries dated consultation calendars for CEE.

coverage_gaps.description: The highest-value SI-specific commentary index (Tax-Fin-Lex strokovni članki) is partly behind a subscription, and two other key channels are bot-defended.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide early whether a Tax-Fin-Lex licence is in scope; otherwise cap expectations at title/date/abstract metadata, and provision a browser-grade fetcher for PwC SI and CEE Legal Matters.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell rationale expects advisers to flag enforcement trends invisible elsewhere, but no SI source was found publishing recurring enforcement or supervisory-practice commentary for banks and payment institutions.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe firm feeds specifically for 'nadzorni ukrep', 'globa', 'inšpekcijski nadzor' plus Banka Slovenije, and check whether Bančni vestnik carries a recurring supervision column.

coverage_gaps.description: Section paths for Večer and Siol.net business desks were inferred from naming conventions, not observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch each homepage with a browser-like agent and read the real navigation to capture correct section and feed URLs.

coverage_gaps.description: Specialist sl fintech/payments trade press and banking-law commentary blogs (e.g. law-firm bulletins, IUS-INFO/Tax-Fin-Lex commentary) were not covered by this cell's media brief but carry the same contested-deadline signal.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a legal/professional-commentary sub-cell covering law-firm newsletters and Slovenian legal-information services in sl.

coverage_gaps.description: The two highest-value outlets for this cell (Finance.si, STA) are both commercially gated; free tiers give headlines only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for a Finance.si subscription and an STA content licence, or restrict collection to headline/metadata level and accept reduced depth.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival access route was identified for retrospective sl media coverage (Digitalna knjižnica Slovenije / dLib, media archives) to reconstruct past consultation controversies.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe dLib.si and outlet archive pages for historical sl banking coverage and note licence terms.

coverage_gaps.description: Tržni inšpektorat RS (TIRS) — the market inspectorate enforcing ZVPot-1 — was named in searches but no TIRS page, annual report or enforcement-decision listing was located for this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted pass on gov.si/drzavni-organi/organi-v-sestavi/trzni-inspektorat with SL terms 'letno poročilo', 'nadzor', 'nepoštene poslovne prakse', 'finančne storitve'.

coverage_gaps.description: Annual reports of Banka Slovenije's consumer-protection/conduct supervision and of the ZBS IRPS provider (letno poročilo izvajalca IRPS, mandatory under ZIsRPS) were not individually located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl bsi.si/sl/publikacije and zbs-giz.si for 'letno poročilo' filtered on varstvo potrošnikov / IRPS; these are the core recurring quantitative series for this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Parliamentary/consultation trail — Državni zbor committee materials and ZPS's formal submitted comments (pripombe) on consumer/payments drafts — not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add dz-rs.si committee (Odbor za gospodarstvo) document search and look for ZPS position papers/stališča PDFs on zps.si.

coverage_gaps.description: Basic payment account (osnovni plačilni račun) access refusals, de-risking and financial-exclusion complaints were seen only in passing; no dedicated source pinned.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'osnovni plačilni račun zavrnitev banka pritožba' and check BSI's payment-account pages and the Varuh's reports.

coverage_gaps.description: Court-level consumer-vs-bank case law (sodna praksa, e.g. CHF loan litigation via Združenje Frank) borders this cell and shapes ADR outcomes, but was not systematically covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sodnapraksa.si search on ZPlaSSIED/ZPotK and monitor zdruzenje-frank.si as an organised-claimant actor.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin by nature — only EU-level sources (FIN-NET, EC ADR pages) and ZBS's /en/adr/ page are in English.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan collection predominantly in Slovenian with machine translation; do not rely on EN mirrors of national bodies, which lag or do not exist.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank payment institutions, e-money institutions and crypto-asset service providers licensed in SI were not individually enumerated; their career pages and hiring signals are unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the BS register of supervised entities (and ATVP register) to build the full PSP/EMI/CASP list, then map each entity's career page URL as a monitored source.

coverage_gaps.description: Big-four and law-firm SI regulatory event/webinar calendars (Deloitte, PwC, KPMG, EY, and SI law firms) were not searched; these are prolific indirect indicators of which regulations clients are paying to prepare for.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sweep on 'webinar'/'seminar'/'delavnica' + regulation names restricted to sl-language advisory-firm domains.

coverage_gaps.description: No page in this slice was fetched; all URLs come from search-result metadata and are unverified for liveness and for whether the expected content is present at that exact path.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route every candidate through the deterministic liveness/verification pass; treat any 403 as bot-defence rather than dead.

coverage_gaps.description: Job postings and event agendas are ephemeral — postings are removed on close and agenda pages are overwritten each edition. No archival strategy is established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot every discovered posting/agenda to local storage at discovery time and register key URLs with a web archive so a longitudinal hiring/agenda series can be built.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian court/misdemeanour decision databases (e.g. sodnapraksa.si, Uradni list RS) were not searched for financial-sector penalty decisions, which sometimes surface fines the supervisor does not publish.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a sweep of sodnapraksa.si and uradni-list.si with sl legal terms (prekršek, globa, ZBan, ZPPDFT) as a supplementary sanctions channel.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller SI banks and savings institutions (Delavska hranilnica, Addiko, Gorenjska banka, Sberbank-successor entities) were not individually checked for their own PSD2 developer portals beyond the Bankart hub.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate SI ASPSPs from the Bankart hub and Open Banking Tracker, then locate each institution's own developer/PSD2 page in sl.
